name: GMX Protected Word Count Step
overview: Tallies the [GMX-V 2.0](http://www.xtm-intl.com/manuals/gmx-v/GMX-V-2.0.html) `ProtectedWordCount` category — the word count for text that has been marked as protected, or otherwise not translatable (for example XLIFF text enclosed in `<mrk mtype="protected">` elements). Unlike the match-based GMX steps, this step counts only the units flagged as non-translatable, counting the words in their source; for translatable units it removes any previously recorded protected metric. Counts are stored as GMX-V metrics annotations on segments, text containers, and aggregate resources for downstream consumption (for example by the Scoping Report Step). This is the word-count variant; a companion step counts characters for the same category.
processingNotes: Counts only text units marked non-translatable; this is the one GMX count step that does not restrict itself to translatable units.
For translatable units the step actively removes any existing protected metric from the segment, source, and text unit.
For locales the GMX-V spec treats as logographic, the word count is derived from the character count divided by the per-language factor.
